summary: The PrfEmailMessages document concerns managing email messages related to staff profiles within a web application. It includes functionality for displaying, editing, inserting, and deleting email messages, with integration for caching and session management.
purpose: To provide functionality for managing staff email messages within the web application, including CRUD operations and validation.
validations: Email type must be selected from dropdown
Screen is editable based on session state
system_behavior: Auto-generated fields are modified directly in code-behind
Redirects on save and delete actions
Handles objects from data source selecting and updating
